sections.translation:
## Ethernet Connection for Remote Control

The console features an **Ethernet port** for remote control via a local area network (LAN). The **built-in web control interface** is accessed using a web browser from any computer connected to the same network.
sections.title: Conexión Ethernet para control remoto

sections.translation: ### Step 1: Physical Connection Connect the **CONTROL ETHERNET** port on the UNIDEX to a port on the **router**, using a standard Ethernet network cable. Do not confuse the Ethernet connector for **CONTROL** with the Ethernet port for **STREAMING**. - From the factory, UNIDEX is configured with **DHCP enabled**. - The router will automatically assign an available IP address. This IP may change when the console is restarted, unless a static IP is configured, but this is usually not necessary (if a static IP is required, go to: `SETTINGS → SYSTEM`). - The current IP address is displayed on the console's **main screen**, under the name:\ **UNIDEX IP.** **Solidyne Multi-Discovery** If you do not have physical access to the console, you can [**download the Multi-Discovery tool**](/es/unidex/unidex-discovery) which detects Solidyne devices connected to the network.
sections.title: Paso 1: Conexión física

sections.translation:
### **Step 2**: Access via Web Browser

From any computer connected to the **same local network** (preferably via cable) open a web browser (recommended: **Google Chrome**) and enter the IP address displayed as **UNIDEX IP**.

This will open the web interface for console operation and configuration. The interface is similar to the one shown on the **onboard touchscreen**.

---
sections.title: **Paso 2**: Acceso desde navegador web

sections.translation: ## Ethernet Connection for Streaming Services 1. Connect the **Streaming Out** port to the LAN router using a standard Ethernet cable. DO NOT CONFUSE the **streaming Ethernet connector** with the **remote control** Ethernet connector.\ Both use RJ45, but serve completely different functions. 2. The router will assign an IP address via **DHCP**, visible on the main screen as: **Stream IP** 3. This IP may change when the console is restarted, unless a static IP is configured. 4. Streaming service configuration can be done in two ways: - From the console's **touch screen**. - From any computer on the network, by accessing the **Stream IP** address from a web browser. **Solidyne Multi-Discovery** If physical access to the console is not available, you can [**download the Multi-Discovery tool**](/es/unidex/unidex-discovery) which detects Solidyne devices connected to the network.
sections.title: Conexión Ethernet para servicios de streaming
